id: title:Piccirello:hide password hash and reset link in user admin

review.posthog_relevance: Potential security improvement by removing sensitive password-related metadata (salt and hash) from Django password widget context, which could help prevent password-related attacks.
review.reason: Adds a new class ReadOnlyPasswordHashWidget that filters out salt and hash from the password widget context, potentially preventing Django's default password widget from displaying sensitive password-related information.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the password reset token removal or the complete UserAdmin class, so the connection between the removed password reset link and the help text removal cannot be fully established.
